# M-EXT5 Bottlenecks

## A — Science / task

- Loss-threshold definition dominates the qualitative outcome (late REJECT vs early SUPPORT).  
- Synthetic scope; MNIST blocked by environment (torchvision/torch mismatch).

## B — Process / GOS

- Mechanical gate before data prevented M-EXT4-style “confirmatory ready” false advertising.  
- Split H_EFFECT ⊥ H_FISHER avoided forcing a single story.

## C — Do not promote

- Do not claim “Mpemba confirmed” from early secondary alone.  
- Do not build ScienceKernel from this.  
- Optional follow-up = new prereg on mid-threshold claim as **primary**, not silent promotion.
